Person.reason: Pty represents parties; IsCstmr identifies bank customers.

Account.reason: CshAcct represents accounts held at the bank.

Transaction.reason: Credit transfer records include settlement fields, but the schema does not confirm execution.

Device.reason: No device vertex or attribute is present.

IPAddress.reason: No IP address vertex or attribute is present.

LoginEvent.reason: No sign-on or authentication records are present.

Beneficiary.reason: Creditors are parties, but the schema does not distinguish saved payees from other non-customer parties.

Card.reason: No card vertex or attribute is present.

Merchant.reason: No merchant vertex or attribute is present.

InvestigationCase.reason: No investigation case vertex or attribute is present.

OWNS.reason: The ownership edge links customer parties to accounts.

INITIATED.reason: The debtor-account edge identifies the account the transfer was instructed from; execution is not confirmed.

PAYS_TO_ACCOUNT.reason: The creditor-account edge exists, but the schema does not establish that the account is held at this bank.

PAYS.reason: The actual creditor party is linked; the schema does not establish that every creditor is an external beneficiary.

FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device data or linking edge is present.

FROM_IP.reason: No IP address data or linking edge is present.

AT.reason: No merchant data or linking edge is present.

VIA.reason: No card data or linking edge is present.

LOGGED_IN.reason: No login events or login-to-account edge is present.

LOGIN_FROM_DEVICE.reason: No login events or device data is present.

LOGIN_FROM_IP.reason: No login events or IP address data is present.

INVESTIGATED_IN.reason: AMLAlrtInd is an alert indicator, not an investigation case.

Transaction.amount.reason: Settlement amount is available, but the transfer record is not confirmed executed.

Transaction.timestamp.reason: Settlement date is available, but time of day is not indicated.

Transaction.channel.reason: No transaction channel attribute is present.

Account.open_date.reason: OpngDt gives the account opening date.

Account.kyc_score.reason: No account-level KYC score is present.

Person.anonymized_ssn_hash.reason: An identity hash exists, but its scheme is not identified as a national identity number.

Person.kyc_verified_at.reason: No identity verification timestamp is present.

Beneficiary.bank_identifier.reason: Creditor-agent bank identifiers are present, but are not attributes of the creditor party itself.

Beneficiary.name_hash.reason: A party name hash is available for non-customer parties, which may include but are not limited to beneficiaries.

InvestigationCase.status.reason: No investigation case or case status is present.

IPAddress.anonymizer.reason: No IP address or anonymizer indicator is present.

account_under_investigation.reason: AMLAlrtInd is an alert flag and may signal investigation, but is not a case record.
